Annual Meetings

Morning Session - 2015 Meeting

Warren Buffett offers an extensive defense of Clayton Homes after the Berkshire subsidiary is accused of predatory lending practices. He also responds to concerns that 3G, Berkshire's partner in acquiring Heinz, is too aggressively cutting jobs, and argues that health concerns over sugar won't stop Coca-Cola's growth.

Sat, May 2 2015 • 9:00 AM EDT
Key Chapters —
  1. 9. Defending Clayton Homes from predatory lending accusations
  2. 10. Defending 3G from accusations of excessive job cuts
  3. 17. Health concerns about sugar won't stop Coca-Cola's growth
  4. 20. Any company with an economist has "one employee too many"
  5. 40. Weschler and Combs are good investors and good people
